info.name: Event Manager - Check-in & Attendance
info.description: Check-in service: assigned-staff and owner checks, check-in window, duplicates (409), people arrived, undo rules (own / 15 min / until completed), live counts, final report after completion. The run waits about 70 seconds for the test event to start.
